info.title: Skills England Occupation Maps - Public API
info.description: Get Skills England's latest occupation standards and occupational map data from the occupational maps API.

get.summary: Returns a custom Occupational Map representing a specific set of occupations
get.description:
All the specified occupations will be returned in their appropriate location within the occupational map hierarchy.
            
Occupations in multiple routes may be returned.  A route contains pathways, pathways contain cluster groups, cluster groups contain clusters (each of which is at a specific technical level), clusters contain occupations.
            
Additional information about the occupations can be included by using the expand parameter.
            
If includeCompleteMapHierarchy is false (default), only the routes, pathways, cluster groups and clusters which contain the occupations specified will be returned, if it is false, then the full hierarchy will be returned, even if it is empty.
            
Please note that the max URL length is 2048 chars, this will restrict how many occCodes and expansions it will be possible to request.

parameters.name: occCodes
parameters.description: Comma separated list of Occupation codes to be included in the custom map.

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description:
Optional parameter to allow expanding the response. Possible expansions include (as a comma separated list):
    occupation.overview,
    occupation.summary,
    occupation.soc,
    occupation.maphierarchy,
    occupation.typicaljobtitles,
    occupation.dutiesKSB,
    occupation.green,
    occupation.products,
    occupation.links,
    occupation.keywords,
    occupation.involvedemployers,
    occupation.salary,
    occupation.ssa,
    product.links (requires occupation.products),
    product.ssa (requires occupation.products),
    green.links (requires occupation.green)

parameters.name: includeCompleteMapHierarchy
parameters.description: Include all the routes, pathways, cluster groups and clusters even if they are empty

get.summary: Returns the occupational progression data for a specified occupation.
get.description:
Occupation codes can be retrieved from one of the route endpoints or via the search endpoint.  
            
This endpoint will return a list of occupations for which progression exists to or from the specified occupation.  The progression mappings will indicate whether the progression is to or from the specified occupation. 
            
Additional information about the occupations can be included by using the expand parameter.

get.summary: Returns a list of occupations matching the search term entered
get.description:
This search will return a list of occupations where any word in the search term entered appears in the following fields: occupation code, occupation name, typical job titles, keywords, product code and name of associated technical education product.  There is some synonym and stem matching.  
            
Sorting is determined by how often the searched words appear in the occupation and how close the search terms are to each other.  Occupations where the search term appears in the occupation name are ranked highest.
            
If an occupation code is searched for, just that occupation will be returned - in this scenario it would be more efficient to use the /Occupations endpoint.
            
Additional information about the occupations can be included by using the expand parameter.
            
Results are returned paginated.

parameters.name: searchTerm
parameters.description: Required, max length 500.

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description:
Optional parameter to allow expanding the response. Possible expansions include (as a comma separated list):
    occupation.overview,

get.summary: Returns the technical education progression data for a specific product code.
get.description:
Product codes can be retrieved via their associated occupation by expanding occupation.products.
            
This endpoint will return a list of technical education products for which progression exists to or from the specified product. A list of job tiles and / or a list of non-technical education qualifications may be included.

parameters.name: productCode
parameters.description: Required.

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description:
Optional parameter to allow expanding the response. Possible expansions include (as a comma separated list):
    product.links,
    product.ssa

v1_0.Models.Behaviour.description: Behaviour information for this occupation.  This is included if the expansion 'occupation.dutiesKSB' is requested.

v1_0.Models.Cluster.description: A cluster is a container for occupations within the same cluster group and technical level.

v1_0.Models.ClusterGroup.description: A cluster group is a group of clusters, it sits within a pathway.

v1_0.Models.Duty.description: Duties information for this occupation.  This is included if the expansion 'occupation.dutiesKSB' is requested.  Duties are also mapped to the knowledge, skills and behaviours.

v1_0.Models.GreenOccupation.description: Green information for this occupation.  This is included if the expansion 'occupation.green' is requested.

v1_0.Models.GreenTheme.description: A list of all the green themes and their sub-themes. If the expansion 'occupation.links' is requested, related URLs and API endpoints will be included.

v1_0.Models.Knowledge.description: Knowledge information for this occupation.  This is included if the expansion 'occupation.dutiesKSB' is requested.

v1_0.Models.Link.description: Links to URLs and API endpoints.

v1_0.Models.MapHierarchy.description: How this occupation is positioned in the map.  This is included if the expansion 'occupation.maphierarchy' is requested.

stdCode.description: The occupation standard code - starts with 'OCC', followed by any 4 digits, and ends with a single optional letter.

status.description: The ID for the status of the occupation standard. This corresponds to the ID returned in the /OccupationalStates endpoint

statusName.description: The name of the status of the occupation standard.

level.description: The level of the occupation standard.

summary.description: The Summary for this Occupation.  This is included if the expansion 'occupation.summary' is requested.

overview.description: The Overview for this Occupation.  This is included if the expansion 'occupation.overview' is requested.

involvedEmployers.description: The employers who were involved in creating this occupational standard.  This is included if the expansion 'occupation.involvedEmployers' is requested.

keywords.description: The keywords for this occupation.  This is included if the expansion 'occupation.keywords' is requested.

links.description: Links related to this occupation.  This is included if the expansion 'occupation.links' is requested.

v1_0.Models.OccupationalProgressionMap.description: This response includes an expandable collection of occupations relating to this occupational progression map and a list of progression mappings indicating whether the progression is to or from the key occupation.

v1_0.Models.Pagination.PaginatedResults`.description: A model to represent a set of paginated results of a particular type

totalMatched.description: The total number of matched records

totalReturned.description: The total number of returned records e.g. The current page size

hasMoreItems.description: Indicates whether there are any more items to be paged through

links.description: A collection of links to aid in pagination

v1_0.Models.Pathway.description: A pathway is a collection of cluster groups.  A pathway is within a route.

v1_0.Models.Product.description: Associated products for the occupation.  This is included if the expansion 'occupation.products' is requested and the related links are included if the expansion 'products.links' is also included.

v1_0.Models.Route.description: A route is a collections of pathways.  The Institute has 15 routes.

v1_0.Models.SOCCode.description: Information about the Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) which has been mapped to this occupational standard.  This is included if the expansion 'occupation.soc' is requested.

v1_0.Models.SectorSubjectArea.description: The Sector Subject Area and Sub-Sector Subject Area for the Occupation

v1_0.Models.Skill.description: Skill information for the occupation.  This is included if the expansion 'occupation.dutiesKSB' is requested.

v1_0.Models.TEPEducationOptions.description:
Non-technical education qualifications are grouped according to their technical level.
'Technical' relates to qualification levels 2 and 3.
'Higher Technical' relates to qualification levels 4 and 5.
'Professional' relates to qualification levels 6 and 7.

v1_0.Models.TEPWorkOptions.description:
Job titles are grouped according to their technical level.
'Technical' relates to work requiring qualification levels 2 and 3.
'Higher Technical' relates to work requiring qualification levels 4 and 5.
'Professional' relates to work requiring qualification levels 6 and 7.

v1_0.Models.TechnicalEducation.description: The technical education products for which progression has been identified.

v1_0.Models.TechnicalEducationProgressio.description:
This response shows potential progression which has been identified from the key technical education product.
            
It may include: technical education products, non-technical education qualifications and a list of potential job titles.
            
For technical education products a progression type will be given, this can be used to indicate if the progression is accelerated, not applicable or to be confirmed.

v1_0.Models.TypicalJobTitle.description: The typical job titles for this occupation.  This is included if the expansion 'occupation.typicaljobtitles' is requested.
